chunks: That is because God has revealed the Book containing the truth; but those who are at variance about it have gone astray in their contrariness.
ai.seo_question: Why do people disagree about the Quran according to this verse?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the dispute over the Quran's interpretation (ta'wil) and authority, particularly emphasizing the role of the Ahl al-Bayt as the true custodians of its truth. It underscores that deviation from the divine Book leads to 'shiqqaq' (deep schism), a theme central to understanding the unity of the Muslim community under the Imams. The verse serves as a warning against sectarianism arising from subjective or conflicting interpretations of the scripture.
